title: Email username
statementMd:
Show each employee's email username (the part before `@`) in upper case.

Expected columns: `username`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT UPPER(substr(email, 1, instr(email, '@') - 1)) AS username FROM employees;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
